dialogue.origin: こんにちは今日はよろしくお願いします
dialogue.content: Hello. Thank you for being here today.

dialogue.origin: 心理カウンセラーの恋愛のテーマです
dialogue.content: This is a psychological counseling session on the theme of romance.

dialogue.origin: ダメージを受けた恋愛相談をよろしくお願いいたします
dialogue.content: I'd like to do a counseling session about a damaging romantic experience.

dialogue.origin: こちらの文章は届いておりますでしょうか
dialogue.content: Have you received this message?

dialogue.origin: こちらこそ、よろしくお願いします。だめーじですね。
dialogue.content: Likewise, thank you. So, a “damaged” relationship, right?

dialogue.origin: はい、よろしくお願いいたします
dialogue.content: Yes, thank you.

dialogue.origin: 婚活とかではなく、恋愛で悩んでいるクライアント役を演じて頂けたら、と思います
dialogue.content: I'd like you to play the role of a client who is troubled by a romantic relationship, rather than marriage hunting.

dialogue.origin: はい、承知しました
dialogue.content: Yes, understood.

dialogue.origin: こんにちは相談員です今日のご相談はどのようなご相談でしょうか
dialogue.content: Hello, I'm your counselor. What would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.origin: 最近、彼よ様子がおかしくて、不安なんです
dialogue.content: Lately, my boyfriend has been acting strange, and I’m anxious.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですねそれは心配ですね
dialogue.content: I see. That must be worrying.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: どのような様子なのか詳しく教えていただけますでしょうか。
dialogue.content: Could you tell me more about how he's been acting?

dialogue.origin: 最近、向こうから連絡が来ないんです
dialogue.content: Recently, he hasn't been contacting me.

dialogue.origin: それはますます心配で不安になってしまいますよね
dialogue.content: That would make you even more worried and anxious, wouldn't it?

dialogue.origin: そうなんです
dialogue.content: It does.

dialogue.origin: よろしければ、あなたと彼さんの年齢と性別を教えていただけますでしょうか。
dialogue.content: If you don't mind, could you tell me your age and gender, and his as well?

dialogue.origin: 私は、29才女性。彼は27才です
dialogue.content: I'm a 29-year-old woman. He's 27.

dialogue.origin: 教えて頂きありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you for sharing that.

dialogue.origin: いつ頃から、どこでお知り合いになりましたか？
dialogue.content: When and where did you two meet?

dialogue.origin: ３年前に、コンパで会って付き合い始めました
dialogue.content: We met at a group mixer three years ago and started dating.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですねもう長いお付き合いなんですねよけいに連絡がなくなって・・となると辛くなってきてしまいますよね
dialogue.content: I see. You’ve been together for quite a while. That must make it even more painful when the contact stops.

dialogue.origin: はい…
dialogue.content: Yes...

dialogue.origin: 最近というと、今まではどのくらい頻繁に連絡を取り合っていましたか？
dialogue.content: You said "recently," so how often did you used to communicate before this?

dialogue.origin: 元々、とても忙しがっている人で、週１位だったかな
dialogue.content: He's always been a very busy person, so maybe about once a week.

dialogue.origin: そうだったんですね・・連絡がこなくなったきっかけとかは思いつきますでしょうか
dialogue.content: I see… Can you think of anything that might have triggered him to stop contacting you?

dialogue.origin: きっかけは特に思い当たらないんですけど…
dialogue.content: I can’t think of any particular trigger, but…

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: 実は、
dialogue.content: Actually...

dialogue.origin: はい（聞いてますね）
dialogue.content: Yes, I’m listening.

dialogue.origin: 浮気してることがわかったことがあったので、疑ってます
dialogue.content: I found out he was cheating before, so I'm suspicious now.

dialogue.origin: そうだったんですね・・それはショックですね
dialogue.content: I see… That must have been a shock.

dialogue.origin: やっぱり、決まり、ですよね
dialogue.content: It’s the same pattern as before, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: 疑ってしまうと、余計にどうしたらいいか戸惑ってしまいますよね
dialogue.content: Once you start suspecting, it makes you even more confused about what to do, doesn't it?

dialogue.origin: 浮気をしているとわかったのは、どんなことがあったんでしょうか
dialogue.content: How did you find out that he was cheating?

dialogue.origin: 前に浮気された時と同じパターンで、わかりやすいんです
dialogue.content: It's the same pattern as the last time he cheated, so it's easy to tell.

dialogue.origin: そうだったんですね・・
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: どんなパターンでしょうか
dialogue.content: What kind of pattern is it?

dialogue.origin: 共通の仲間がいるんだけど
dialogue.content: We have mutual friends,

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: 仕事でむり"と彼に言われたのに、その人経由で、飲み屋で見た、って耳に入ったんです
dialogue.content: He told me he couldn't because of work, but through one of them, I heard that he'd been seen at a bar.

dialogue.origin: そんなことがあったんですねまさか・・って思ってしまいますよね
dialogue.content: So that's what happened... It makes you think, "No way...," doesn't it?

dialogue.origin: わかりやすいんです
dialogue.content: It's so obvious.

dialogue.origin: 飲み屋ではほかの女性と一緒だったんですね
dialogue.content: So he was with another woman at the bar, right?

dialogue.origin: そうみたいです
dialogue.content: It seems so.

dialogue.origin: それを聞いて、あなたは彼に何か言いましたか？
dialogue.content: After hearing that, did you say anything to him?

dialogue.origin: LINEで聞いたんですけど、シラを切っています
dialogue.content: I asked him about it over LINE, but he's playing innocent.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですねそれは納得がいかず腹立たしく思ってしまいますよね
dialogue.content: I see. That must be so frustrating and hard to accept, mustn't it?

dialogue.origin: 許せません
dialogue.content: I can’t forgive him.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね許せなくなるお気持ちはもっともだと思います普段彼氏さんとはどのような会話をしてますか？
dialogue.content: I understand. Your feelings of being unable to forgive him are completely valid. What are your conversations with your boyfriend normally like?

dialogue.origin: あなたのことを大切にしている感じでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Does it feel like he cherishes you?

dialogue.origin: 今思うと、
dialogue.content: Now that I think about it,

dialogue.origin: うん、うん
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm, mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: （お話続けてくださいね）
dialogue.content: (Please go on.)

dialogue.origin: 遊びや趣味のこととか、いつも愉快な話が殆どで、
dialogue.content: We mostly had fun conversations about things like our hobbies and outings,

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: あんまり深い話とかはしてこなかったかも。
dialogue.content: I guess we haven't really had many deep conversations.

dialogue.origin: そっか・・なんだか表面的な会話だったかも？と思われるのですね
dialogue.content: I see… So you feel that your conversations might have been somewhat superficial?

dialogue.origin: 本当は、大切な話もしたかったのに。
dialogue.content: But I really wanted to talk about important things, too.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね大切な話って例えばどんなお話でしょうか
dialogue.content: I see. What kinds of important things did you want to talk about?

dialogue.origin: 友だちはみんな、結婚し始めていて、"次はあなたの番だね＂ってよく言われてて…
dialogue.content: All my friends are starting to get married, and they often tell me, "You're next"...

dialogue.origin: なんかそんな時、なんて言ったらいいかわかんなくて、
dialogue.content: At times like that, I don't know what to say,

dialogue.origin: うん、うん
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm, mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: 本当は結婚のこととか、お話したかったのに・・
dialogue.content: You actually wanted to talk about marriage and things like that, but…

dialogue.origin: 言い出さないような雰囲気だったんでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Did the atmosphere make it feel like you couldn't bring it up?

dialogue.origin: モヤモヤするからまんま、彼に話そうとは思ったけど、言い出せずにきた
dialogue.content: I was feeling uneasy, so I thought about telling him directly how I felt, but I haven't been able to bring myself to do it.

dialogue.origin: ここまでのお話をいったんまとめさせて頂くと、いつも楽しく会話していたんだけど、３年もおお付き合いしてきたのにもしかしたらもっと深いお話をしていなかったかも
dialogue.content: Let me try to summarize what we've discussed. You've always had fun conversations, but even after being together for three years, you feel that you might not have had deeper talks.

dialogue.origin: と思ってしまうんですね
dialogue.content: That’s how you’re feeling, is that right?

dialogue.origin: ここまでのお話を伺感じたことをお伝えしてもよろしいでしょうか
dialogue.content: May I share my thoughts on what I've heard so far?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: あなたは大切に扱われていい存在だと思います
dialogue.content: I believe you are a person who deserves to be treated with care.

dialogue.origin: これで終了ボタン押させていただきますね）
dialogue.content: I will press the end button now.)

topic.sub: 彼の浮気疑惑とコミュニケーション不足
